parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols oam cfm version standard.command: set protocols oam cfm version standard
set protocols oam cfm version standard.explanation: 配置OAM CFM的版本为标准版本。

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level [parameter2]
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 level 3

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: 维护域的级别，范围从0到7。

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2]
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.explanation: 配置维护域中的维护关联。

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4] direction [parameter5]
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 mep 31 interface ge-1/0/1.1 direction inward
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.explanation: 配置维护端点(MEP)的接口和方向。

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ais-enable
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 mep 31 ais-enable

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ais-interval [parameter4]
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 mep 31 ais-interval 60

parameters.name: ais-interval
parameters.explanation: AIS消息的间隔时间，单位为秒。

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] vlan [parameter4]
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 mep 31 vlan 10

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 remote-mep 32

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] ccm-receive-enable
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 remote-mep 32 ccm-receive-enable
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.explanation: 启用远程维护端点的CCM接收功能。

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.template: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] ais-enable
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.command: set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain md1 maintenance-association ma1 remote-mep 32 ais-enable
set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.explanation: 启用远程维护端点的AIS功能。

set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1.0 family etherne.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1.0 family ethernet-switching vlan-tagging

set interfaces ge-1/0/1.1 encapsulation.explanation: 配置接口的封装类型为vlan-ccc。

set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.template: set protocols l2circuit neighbor [parameter1] interface [parameter2] virtual-circuit-id [parameter3]
set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.command: set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3 interface ge-1/0/1.1 virtual-circuit-id 100
set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.explanation: 配置L2电路的邻居、接口和虚拟电路ID。

parameters.name: virtual-circuit-id
parameters.explanation: 虚拟电路ID，用于标识电路。

set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.template: set protocols l2circuit neighbor [parameter1] interface [parameter2] encapsulation-type [parameter3]
set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.command: set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3 interface ge-1/0/1.1 encapsulation-type mpls
set protocols l2circuit neighbor 3.3.3.3.explanation: 配置L2电路的封装类型为MPLS。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/30
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
